not_enforceable: destination 'development-fixture' (127.0.0.1) includes loopback addresses, which playpen refuses: inside the sandbox loopback is the sandbox's own, and the host's cannot be approved
enforcement.why: playpen cannot enforce this pass: destination 'development-fixture' (127.0.0.1) includes loopback addresses, which playpen refuses: inside the sandbox loopback is the sandbox's own, and the host's cannot be approved. With enforcement on (the default once playpen is found, or --enforce) the engine does not start; --no-enforce runs it on teapot's own gate, and a pass without such a destination can be enforced

lock.note: the lock stops the policy changing through teapot's own commands; it is not containment: a process sharing your shell can edit files, restart the engine or run other tools (use --enforce for containment)
